## 2 and 10 yr yields

```{r}
# Define the Treasury yield symbols from FRED:
# - DGS2 = 2-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate
# - DGS10 = 10-Year Treasury Constant Maturity Rate

# Get fresh data from FRED (Federal Reserve Economic Data)
getSymbols(c("DGS2", "DGS10"), src = "FRED")

# Combine the data into one data frame
yield_data <- merge(DGS2, DGS10)
colnames(yield_data) <- c("Two_Year", "Ten_Year")

# Keep only complete cases (remove rows with NA values)
yield_data <- na.omit(yield_data)

# Get the most recent date in the data
last_date <- tail(index(yield_data), 1)

# Static ggplot2 version
ggplot_df <- data.frame(Date = index(yield_data), coredata(yield_data))

ggplot(ggplot_df, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Two_Year, color = "2-Year Yield"), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Ten_Year, color = "10-Year Yield"), linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("2-Year Yield" = "blue", "10-Year Yield" = "red")) +
  labs(title = paste("US Treasury Yields (Last Updated:", last_date, ")"),
       x = "Date", 
       y = "Yield (%)",
       color = "Yield Curve") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# Interactive dygraphs version
dygraph(yield_data, main = paste("US Treasury Yields (Last Updated:", last_date, ")")) %>%
  dySeries("Two_Year", label = "2-Year Yield", color = "blue") %>%
  dySeries("Ten_Year", label = "10-Year Yield", color = "red") %>%
  dyAxis("y", label = "Yield (%)") %>%
  dyRangeSelector() %>%
  dyLegend(show = "always")
```



## Prisdata på assets fra aktiesparekonto positivliste

This starting point code doesn't get any data, but it might give some ideas...
```{r}
# Load required packages
if (!require("httr")) install.packages("httr")
if (!require("readxl")) install.packages("readxl")
if (!require("quantmod")) install.packages("quantmod")
if (!require("dplyr")) install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("purrr")) install.packages("purrr")
if (!require("jsonlite")) install.packages("jsonlite")
library(httr)
library(readxl)
library(quantmod)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(jsonlite)

# 1. Download the ABIS list from SKAT
abis_url <- "https://skat.dk/media/ae2a1pew/abis-listen-2020-2025-juli-25.xlsx"
temp_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")
GET(abis_url, write_disk(temp_file, overwrite = TRUE))

# 2. Read the specific sheet and column
cat("Reading ISIN codes from '2025' sheet...\n")
abis_data <- read_excel(temp_file, sheet = "2025") 
isins <- unique(abis_data$`ISIN-kode`)
isins <- isins[!is.na(isins)] # Remove NA values

cat("Found", length(isins), "unique ISINs in the ABIS list\n")

# 3. Function to convert ISIN to ticker using various methods
get_ticker_from_isin <- function(isin) {
  tryCatch({
    # Method 1: Yahoo Finance ISIN search
    yahoo_url <- paste0("https://query2.finance.yahoo.com/v1/finance/search?q=", isin)
    yahoo_res <- fromJSON(content(GET(yahoo_url), "text"))
    
    if (length(yahoo_res$quotes) > 0) {
      return(yahoo_res$quotes$symbol[1])
    }
    
    # Method 2: OpenFIGI API (free tier available)
    # figi_url <- "https://api.openfigi.com/v3/mapping"
    # figi_body <- toJSON(list(list(idType = "ID_ISIN", idValue = isin)))
    # figi_res <- POST(figi_url, 
    #                 body = figi_body,
    #                 content_type("application/json"),
    #                 add_headers(`X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY` = "")) # Add your API key if available
    # 
    # if (status_code(figi_res) == 200) {
    #   figi_data <- fromJSON(content(figi_res, "text"))
    #   if (length(figi_data[[1]]$ticker) > 0) {
    #     return(figi_data[[1]]$ticker)
    #   }
    # }
    
    # Method 3: Manual exchange-specific mapping
    # Add known ISIN-ticker mappings here
    # manual_mapping <- list(
    #   "DK0010268606" = "NOVO-B.CO",  # Example: Novo Nordisk
    #   "DK0010272634" = "MAERSK-B.CO" # Example: Maersk
    # )
    
    # if (isin %in% names(manual_mapping)) {
    #   return(manual_mapping[[isin]])
    # }
    
    return(NA) # Return NA if no ticker found
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Error converting ISIN ", isin, ": ", e$message)
    return(NA)
  })
}

# 4. Create ISIN to ticker mapping (with caching to avoid repeated API calls)
if (file.exists("isin_ticker_cache.rds")) {
  isin_ticker_map <- readRDS("isin_ticker_cache.rds")
} else {
  isin_ticker_map <- list()
}

new_isins <- setdiff(isins, names(isin_ticker_map))
if (length(new_isins) > 0) {
  cat("Looking up tickers for", length(new_isins), "new ISINs...\n")
  new_mappings <- map(setNames(new_isins, new_isins), get_ticker_from_isin)
  isin_ticker_map <- c(isin_ticker_map, new_mappings)
  saveRDS(isin_ticker_map, "isin_ticker_cache.rds")
}

# 5. Get price data for all found tickers
get_price_data <- function(ticker) {
  if (is.na(ticker)) return(NULL)
  
  tryCatch({
    data <- getSymbols(ticker, auto.assign = FALSE, from = "2020-01-01")
    if (nrow(data) > 0) {
      colnames(data) <- c("Open", "High", "Low", "Close", "Volume", "Adjusted")
      return(data)
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Error getting data for ", ticker, ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# 6. Process all ISINs
results <- map(isins, ~{
  isin <- .x
  ticker <- isin_ticker_map[[isin]]
  
  if (is.na(ticker)) {
    cat("No ticker found for ISIN:", isin, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cat("Processing", isin, "->", ticker, "\n")
  price_data <- get_price_data(ticker)
  
  if (!is.null(price_data)) {
    data.frame(
      Date = index(price_data),
      ISIN = isin,
      Ticker = ticker,
      coredata(price_data),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  }
})

# 7. Combine and save results
final_data <- bind_rows(compact(results))

if (!is.null(final_data) && nrow(final_data) > 0) {
  output_file <- "abis_asset_prices_with_tickers.csv"
  write.csv(final_data, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\nSuccessfully saved price data for", length(unique(final_data$ISIN)), 
      "assets to", output_file, "\n")
  
  # Show success rate
  success_rate <- length(unique(final_data$ISIN))/length(isins)
  cat(sprintf("Success rate: %.1f%%\n", success_rate * 100))
} else {
  cat("\nWarning: No price data was retrieved for any ISINs\n")
}

# 8. Create a summary of found/missing tickers
ticker_summary <- data.frame(
  ISIN = isins,
  Ticker = unlist(isin_ticker_map[isins]),
  DataAvailable = isins %in% unique(final_data$ISIN)
)

write.csv(ticker_summary, "ticker_mapping_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
